chapter_seo_title: Gao Zhijian Becomes Emperor While Ji Lin Falls to Despair — Chapter 571
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang reveals Gao Zhijian’s true identity as the heir to Great Liang’s throne. Ji Lin’s final breakdown and suicide lay bare the horrific cost of imperial power.
og_title: The Emperor’s Burden: A Coronation and a Suicide
og_description: Gao Zhijian accepts the throne, but Ji Lin’s tragic death reminds us that in the Dao-Twisted World, power is never a gift—it’s a curse.
twitter_title: Gao Zhijian is crowned emperor while Ji Lin takes her own life.
twitter_description: A bittersweet coronation and a devastating suicide reveal the true nature of the Mandate of Heaven.
